serviceIntake.held: Service coverage is no longer confirmed. Contact the responsible person for clarification or a manual alternative.

filterDraftHint: Changes are a draft. Apply updates the results; closing discards these changes.
homeTitle: Find a property with MS Realty
homeLead: Browse published properties for sale and long-term rent. Discuss selling, letting or your next step with the team.
searchHint: Enter a place, keyword or property reference (MS-…). Suggestions come from the place registry; you can also type your own text.
messageOverLimit: {count} characters over the limit. Shorten the text before sending; the draft stays in this tab.
saveLimit: Save up to 50 properties in this browser.
offlineSearch: You appear to be offline. Results may be out of date. Reconnect and search again; inquiries are not sent automatically.
emptyPage: There are no current results on this page. Return to the first page.

contentLabels.unavailable: Approved information is not yet available for this page.

inquiryPhotos.title: Optional photos
inquiryPhotos.lead: Your inquiry has already been received. Photos stay private for assessment; they do not publish a listing or establish ownership.
inquiryPhotos.limits: Up to 3 photos, each up to 8 MiB, in JPEG, PNG or WebP format. Do not send identity or ownership documents.
inquiryPhotos.permission: I declare that I can share this photo for assessment of this inquiry.
inquiryPhotos.upload_incomplete: Upload is not confirmed. Select the same photo to try again.
inquiryPhotos.scanning: Stored privately; waiting for file checks.
inquiryPhotos.available_for_review: Stored privately; file checks completed. Human assessment is pending.
inquiryPhotos.held: Held privately and unavailable for review. Contact the team.
inquiryPhotos.unavailable: Photos cannot be attached here. Contact the team; your inquiry already exists.
inquiryPhotos.failed: This photo could not be attached. Select the same photo when retrying. Your inquiry has already been received.
inquiryPhotos.limitReached: The photo limit has been reached. Discuss further material with the team.
inquiryPhotos.later: After the inquiry is received, you may optionally attach private photos from its receipt.
inquiryPhotos.coverage: The team will check whether it can help with this location and requested service. The inquiry does not confirm coverage or a referral to another provider.
inquiryPhotos.outside: Is the location outside confirmed coverage?
inquiryPhotos.evidenceLead: Private material attached to this inquiry. Each available link rechecks your current access and file evidence.

propertyFacts.confirmLead: These facts are not settled in the current listing. Ask the team.
propertyFacts.unreadable: This recorded value is not available in this view. Ask the team.

searchAlerts.title: Alerts for this search
searchAlerts.lead: Review the search first. Then choose a verified email and give separate permission for search alerts in your account.
searchAlerts.accountHint: Use your existing account email. Signing in does not subscribe you. If you do not have access, contact the team.
searchAlerts.manualHint: Keep the search link when asking the team for help. Contacting us does not enable alerts or marketing.
searchAlerts.deliveryOff: Email alerts are currently unavailable. You can record or manage your preference, but delivery is not enabled.
searchAlerts.deliveryBoundary: Delivery depends on current consent, an eligible verified email and the agency’s approved alert service. No delivery time is promised.
searchAlerts.unknown: Listings with unknown facts do not match unless you explicitly include results needing confirmation.
searchAlerts.savedNext: Review, pause or unsubscribe in your account preferences. Recording this choice does not confirm email delivery.
searchAlerts.invalid: The search could not be preserved. Review its filters before continuing.
searchAlerts.consent: I reviewed this search and the terms, and choose email alerts for it. This does not enable marketing.
searchAlerts.retained: Your choices are retained. Review the current state before trying again.
searchAlerts.unconfirmed: This change is not confirmed. Check its status before submitting another request.
searchAlerts.existing: A search-alert preference already exists. Review or change it in your account before creating another for the same email.

searchAlertStatus.historicalNote: The details below show the current saved preference. It may have been edited or withdrawn since this request; they are not a snapshot of the original request.
searchAlertStatus.savedCriteriaUnavailable: The saved search details are unavailable here. Check your account preferences.
